gaps: Context for every row: on 2026-11-19 the Mungo, Summit, Goodall and Legacy Homes sites carry a live banner saying the brand 'is now Taylor Morrison' and will 'join Taylor Morrison' in 2027; the same banner sits unpublished (staged, not shown to visitors) in the Arbor, Elite and Silverthorne page source. No such banner was found on the Oakwood, Brohn, Chafin, Harris Doyle, Highland or Berkeley sites. Berkshire Hathaway closed its purchase of Taylor Morrison on 2026-07-24 (TMHC 8-K). No press release explaining the combination was found in this run; division titles and reporting lines are likely to change.
Division leaders named only in local business journals, HBA/BIA boards or conference speaker lists: not checked. This file rests on company sites and a few press pages.

Arbor Homes (Indianapolis, Louisville, Columbus, Cincinnati/Dayton): current president and division leaders not found. The site names only founder Curtis Rector (founded 1994). Mike Campbell was VP of land acquisition and development in a 2017 article; too old to keep.
Silverthorne Homes (Indianapolis): no leader named on the site.
Chafin Communities (Atlanta): no leader named on the site.
Highland Homes (Lakeland, Tampa Bay, Sarasota, Orlando, Ocala FL): site names only founders Bob and Joel Adams; current president and land head not found.
Legacy Homes (Huntsville, AL; linked from the Goodall Homes site): site refers to 'four founders' without names; no president or land head found.
Goodall Homes: brand president not found. All Goodall rows come from 2023-2024 staff data in the page source and are tagged Inferred. No Knoxville or Bowling Green division leader found.

Oakwood Homes: brand head not publicly named after president and COO Ryan Smith left for Visionary Homes (joined there 2026-06-15, per HousingWire). No Oakwood land acquisition or land development head found by name.

Mungo Homes: market presidents for Charlotte, Greenville/Spartanburg, Savannah/Beaufort, the Triad and Wilmington not found. Successor to retired VP of Land Acquisition & Development Bill Dixon (retired July 2025) not named. The 2026 McGuinn Homes acquisition release names no ongoing McGuinn leader; HousingWire says Kelly McGuinn stays in a senior operating role, title not given.
Summit Homes: no Des Moines, IA division leader found. Berkeley Building Co. (Boise) names no leaders on its site.
Brohn Homes: Houston and San Antonio division leaders and any land head not found.
Harris Doyle Homes: no dedicated land acquisition or development head named; Birmingham has no separate division president listed.
Reporting lines from brand heads up to Clayton Properties Group leadership are not stated on any source opened here and were left blank.
